title: sim2real diffusion: leveraging foundation vision language models for adaptive automated driving
core_idea: Introduce a unified framework that uses conditional latent diffusion combined with foundation vision-language models to learn cross-domain adaptive representations for transferring simulation-trained automated driving systems to reality, providing modular support for alternate foundation models, few-shot fine-tuning, and both textual and image prompts to handle perceptual domain shifts (time of day, weather, seasons, ODDs) while relying on digital-twin calibration for dynamics.
tldr: A framework that leverages conditional latent diffusion and foundation vision-language models to enable adaptive sim-to-real transfer of autonomous driving perception, with modular few-shot and multi-modal prompt capabilities and emphasis on perceptual adaptation.
